items.title: Stripe's AI Chief: How AI Agents Will Buy, Sell, and Pay
items.summary_en:

The dine and dash, but it's for token. When I go and ask my friends and family whether they'd be comfortable letting an agent buy things on their behalf, they usually jump straight to like, well, is it gonna overspend, and is it gonna buy the wrong thing, and can I stop it? It's Emily has an agent who's tasked with running a business, and that includes buying some things and selling some things and making some profits.
